task_family_en: External contact scanning and sensor placement
task_family_cn: 体表接触式扫描与传感器布置
defining_action_en: Move, orient or maintain a sensor in contact with the body to acquire the next observation
defining_action_cn: 移动、定向或维持传感器与体表接触以获得下一次观察
terminal_evidence_en: In-vivo image, sound or physiological signal
terminal_evidence_cn: 在体影像、声音或生理信号
typical_examples_en: Robotic ultrasound; contact OCT; automated auscultation
typical_examples_cn: 机器人超声；接触式 OCT；自动听诊
boundary_rule_en: Contact force only maintains coupling or safety; if tissue response to deliberate loading is the evidence, use 1.2
boundary_rule_cn: 接触力仅用于耦合或安全；若有意加载后的组织响应构成证据，则归入 1.2

task_family_cn: 体表非接触式对准与扫描
defining_action_en: Change viewpoint, stand-off distance, illumination or scan path without purposeful tissue perturbation
defining_action_cn: 在不有意扰动组织的前提下改变视点、工作距离、照明或扫描路径
terminal_evidence_en: In-vivo optical, spectral, thermal or acoustic observation
terminal_evidence_cn: 在体光学、光谱、热学或声学观察
typical_examples_en: Ophthalmic alignment and imaging; skin, wound or exposed-tissue optical/spectral mapping
typical_examples_cn: 眼科主动对准与成像；皮肤、创面或暴露组织的光学/光谱测绘
boundary_rule_en: Classify by the diagnostic channel that drives the next action; modality and body site remain secondary tags
boundary_rule_cn: 按驱动下一步动作的诊断通道归类；模态和部位仅作次级标签

task_family_en: Tethered endoluminal or intracavitary observation and navigation
task_family_cn: 有缆腔内或腔道内观察与导航
defining_action_en: Steer a tethered scope or probe to inspect a lumen or cavity and update navigation from new observations
defining_action_cn: 操控有缆内镜或探头检查管腔/体腔，并用新观察更新导航
terminal_evidence_en: Endoluminal or intracavitary in-vivo image or signal
terminal_evidence_cn: 腔内或体腔内在体影像/信号
typical_examples_en: Flexible gastrointestinal endoscopy; bronchoscopy; otoscopy; laryngoscopy; cystoscopy
typical_examples_cn: 胃肠柔性内镜；支气管镜；耳镜；喉镜；膀胱镜
boundary_rule_en: If material is actually collected for ex-vivo analysis, the sampling episode is 1.3
boundary_rule_cn: 若实际取得材料并进行离体分析，采样阶段归入 1.3

defining_action_en: Actively or magnetically control an untethered device to change internal viewpoint or coverage
defining_action_cn: 主动或磁控无缆装置以改变体内视点或覆盖范围
typical_examples_en: Active or magnetically controlled capsule endoscopy; diagnostic microrobot observation
typical_examples_cn: 主动/磁控胶囊内镜；诊断微型机器人观察
boundary_rule_en: A capsule that obtains tissue or fluid is classified as 1.3 for the sampling episode
boundary_rule_cn: 取得组织或体液的胶囊，其采样阶段归入 1.3

task_family_en: Catheter-based, intravascular, intraductal or percutaneous in-vivo sensing
task_family_cn: 导管、血管内、管道内或经皮探头在体感知
defining_action_en: Advance or steer a minimally invasive sensing probe while the endpoint remains an in-vivo observation
defining_action_cn: 推进或操控微创传感探头，且终点仍为在体观察
terminal_evidence_en: In-vivo image, spectrum or physiological measurement
terminal_evidence_cn: 在体影像、光谱或生理测量
typical_examples_en: Intravascular ultrasound or OCT; steerable intraductal probes; needle-based optical sensing without specimen removal
typical_examples_cn: 血管内超声/OCT；可操控管道内探头；不取材的针式光学感知
boundary_rule_en: If a specimen is removed, classify the sampling episode as 1.3; purely therapeutic catheter actions are excluded
boundary_rule_cn: 若取出样本则采样阶段归入 1.3；纯治疗性导管动作排除

task_family_cn: 准静态接触、触诊与压入
defining_action_en: Apply controlled contact, indentation or compression and measure force-displacement or spatial stiffness
defining_action_cn: 施加受控接触、压入或压缩并测量力—位移或空间刚度
terminal_evidence_en: Elicited force, deformation or stiffness response
terminal_evidence_cn: 诱发的力、形变或刚度响应
typical_examples_en: Robotic palpation; tactile tumor search; compression-based mechanical imaging
typical_examples_cn: 机器人触诊；触觉肿块搜索；压缩式机械成像
boundary_rule_en: Routine contact-force control for sensor coupling is 1.1, not 1.2
boundary_rule_cn: 仅用于传感器耦合的常规接触力控制归入 1.1，而非 1.2

defining_action_en: Apply vibration, impulse, percussion or acoustic radiation force and measure the propagated response
defining_action_cn: 施加振动、冲击、叩击或声辐射力并测量传播响应
terminal_evidence_en: Wave, vibration, resonance or dynamic deformation response
terminal_evidence_cn: 波动、振动、共振或动态形变响应
typical_examples_en: Shear-wave or vibration elastography; robotic percussion; dynamic stiffness mapping
typical_examples_cn: 剪切波/振动弹性成像；机器人叩诊；动态刚度测绘
boundary_rule_en: B-mode imaging used only to guide excitation is a modality tag; the elicited response defines 1.2
boundary_rule_cn: 仅用于引导激励的 B 模式成像是模态标签；诱发响应决定归入 1.2

task_family_en: Imposed motion, loading and functional provocation
task_family_cn: 施加运动、载荷与功能激发
defining_action_en: Move or load a limb or body segment under controlled conditions and measure biomechanical or neuromuscular response
defining_action_cn: 在受控条件下移动或加载肢体/身体节段并测量生物力学或神经肌肉响应
terminal_evidence_en: Laxity, range-of-motion, torque, catch, EMG or functional response
terminal_evidence_cn: 松弛度、活动度、力矩、卡顿、肌电或功能响应
typical_examples_en: Joint laxity testing; passive range-of-motion assessment; tone and spasticity assessment
typical_examples_cn: 关节松弛度检查；被动活动度评估；肌张力与痉挛评估
boundary_rule_en: Therapeutic exercise without a diagnostic response endpoint is excluded
boundary_rule_cn: 没有诊断响应终点的治疗性训练排除

task_family_en: Electrical, magnetic or neurophysiological stimulation-response mapping
task_family_cn: 电、磁或神经生理刺激—响应映射
defining_action_en: Select and apply stimulation parameters or sites, then update mapping from evoked responses
defining_action_cn: 选择并施加刺激参数/位置，再依据诱发响应更新映射
terminal_evidence_en: MEP, EMG, EEG, reflex, electrophysiological or behavioural response
terminal_evidence_cn: MEP、EMG、EEG、反射、电生理或行为响应
typical_examples_en: Closed-loop robotic TMS hotspot mapping; peripheral nerve stimulation-response mapping
typical_examples_cn: 闭环机器人 TMS 热点映射；周围神经刺激—响应映射
boundary_rule_en: Predetermined coil positioning without response-driven updating is a support technology, not a complete embodied diagnostic loop
boundary_rule_cn: 仅按预定位置放置线圈且不依据响应更新者，是支撑技术而非完整具身诊断闭环

defining_action_en: Apply a controlled pressure, occlusion, posture, respiratory, thermal or other physiological challenge and measure recovery or response
defining_action_cn: 施加受控压力、阻断、体位、呼吸、热或其他生理挑战并测量恢复/响应
terminal_evidence_en: Provoked physiological trajectory or recovery response
terminal_evidence_cn: 激发后的生理轨迹或恢复响应
typical_examples_en: Adaptive vascular occlusion testing; controlled respiratory challenge; automated autonomic provocation
typical_examples_cn: 自适应血管阻断试验；受控呼吸挑战；自动自主神经激发
boundary_rule_en: Include only when challenge selection or dosing participates in the diagnostic feedback loop
boundary_rule_cn: 仅当挑战选择或剂量进入诊断反馈闭环时纳入

defining_action_en: Plan and execute needle insertion, aspiration or core acquisition for tissue diagnosis
defining_action_cn: 规划并执行进针、抽吸或芯针取材以获得组织诊断材料
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo histological, cytological or molecular result, including adequacy
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体组织学、细胞学或分子结果，包括样本充分性
typical_examples_en: Core-needle biopsy; fine-needle aspiration; percutaneous image-guided biopsy
typical_examples_cn: 芯针活检；细针抽吸；经皮影像引导活检
boundary_rule_en: Navigation or targeting alone is not sufficient: diagnostic material acquisition or adequacy feedback must be evaluated
boundary_rule_cn: 仅导航或靶向不足以纳入：必须评价诊断材料获取或充分性反馈

defining_action_en: Identify a vessel and execute venipuncture or another blood-acquisition action
defining_action_cn: 识别血管并执行静脉穿刺或其他血液获取动作
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo haematological, biochemical, microbiological or molecular result
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体血液学、生化、微生物或分子结果
typical_examples_en: Robotic venipuncture and phlebotomy; adaptive capillary or arterial sampling
typical_examples_cn: 机器人静脉穿刺与采血；自适应毛细血管/动脉采样
boundary_rule_en: IV placement or infusion without diagnostic specimen collection is an intervention and is excluded
boundary_rule_cn: 不采集诊断样本的静脉置管或输注属于干预，排除

task_family_en: Tethered endoluminal or intracavitary tissue/fluid sampling
task_family_cn: 有缆腔内或腔道内组织/体液采样
defining_action_en: Navigate a tethered instrument and collect tissue, cells or fluid from a lumen or cavity
defining_action_cn: 导航有缆器械并从管腔/体腔采集组织、细胞或体液
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo pathology, cytology, microbiology or molecular result
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体病理、细胞学、微生物或分子结果
typical_examples_en: Robotic bronchoscopic biopsy; endoscopic biopsy; endoluminal brushing or lavage
typical_examples_cn: 机器人支气管镜活检；内镜活检；腔内刷检或灌洗
boundary_rule_en: Observation and navigation are 1.1 stages; the material-acquisition episode is 1.3
boundary_rule_cn: 观察与导航阶段属于 1.1；材料获取阶段属于 1.3

task_family_cn: 无缆或胶囊式体内采样
defining_action_en: Position or trigger an untethered device to capture tissue or luminal fluid and retain it for analysis
defining_action_cn: 定位或触发无缆装置采集组织/腔内体液并保存用于分析
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo tissue, microbiome, metabolite or molecular result
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体组织、微生物组、代谢物或分子结果
typical_examples_en: Capsule biopsy; site-specific gut-fluid or microbiome sampling
typical_examples_cn: 胶囊活检；部位特异性肠液或微生物组采样
boundary_rule_en: Passive transit with timed sampling is a partial system unless location/state feedback changes the sampling action
boundary_rule_cn: 仅随蠕动被动通过并定时采样者属于部分系统，除非位置/状态反馈改变采样动作

defining_action_en: Use a swab, brush, scrape or suction action to acquire a surface or mucosal specimen
defining_action_cn: 以拭子、刷取、刮取或吸取动作获得体表/黏膜标本
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo microbiological, cytological or molecular result
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体微生物、细胞学或分子结果
typical_examples_en: Robotic nasopharyngeal/oropharyngeal swabbing; cervical brushing; wound specimen collection
typical_examples_cn: 机器人鼻咽/口咽拭子；宫颈刷取；创面标本采集
boundary_rule_en: Surface imaging without material removal is 1.1
boundary_rule_cn: 不取材的表面成像归入 1.1

task_family_en: Other adaptive body-fluid or excretion collection
task_family_cn: 其他自适应体液或排泄物采集
defining_action_en: Adaptively acquire saliva, urine, sweat, drainage or another diagnostic fluid when collection itself is a controlled physical task
defining_action_cn: 当采集本身是受控物理任务时，自适应获取唾液、尿液、汗液、引流液或其他诊断体液
terminal_evidence_en: Ex-vivo biochemical, microbiological or molecular result
terminal_evidence_cn: 离体生化、微生物或分子结果
typical_examples_en: Adaptive saliva or urine collection; feedback-controlled drainage specimen acquisition
typical_examples_cn: 自适应唾液/尿液采集；反馈控制的引流液取样
boundary_rule_en: Passive wearable sensing without removing a specimen belongs outside 1.3 and may fall under longitudinal monitoring
boundary_rule_cn: 不取出样本的被动可穿戴感知不属于 1.3，可归入纵向监测
